data.long_meaning: From the Latin name Gilbertus, derived from the Germanic elements gisil (pledge) and berht (bright). This name signifies a bright promise or pledge. The name Gilbertine carries the meaning “Bright pledge” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gilbertine usually hope their child will grow to embody bright pledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: גִּלְבֶּרְטִינָה
in_hebrew.meaning: היא שייכת לחברה גילברטיני, שחברה גילברט
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם גילברטינה מקורו באנגלית, ומשמעותו 'הילד של גילברט'. השם נמצא בפטרונות רבות, כולל פטרונות של הכנסייה. בפטרונות, משמעות השם 'עקרב' או 'שותף'. גם 'אישה גילברט'. השם עצמו 'גילברט' קיבלו 3 נזירים כנסייתיים שהקימו 3 נזיריות. הם הקימו הנזיריות לכבודם הקדושים. 3 נזירים. '3' היא המספר החשוב. 3 נזיריות. הם חבריה ובנות. 'הם' - 'הן'.

in_greek.name: Γιλιβέρτιν
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο τίτλος Γιλβέρτιν προέρχεται από την αγγλική γλώσσα. Η σημασία του είναι 'ο παιδί του Γιλβέρτ'. Ο τίτλος βρίσκεται σε πολλές προνομιότητες, συμπεριλαμβανομένων προνομιότητες της Εκκλησίας. Στις προνομιότητες, η σημασία του τίτλου 'σκαρabajo' ή 'συνεργάτης'. Γιλβέρτ, επίσης, 'γυναίκα Γιλβέρτ'. Ο τίτλος itself 'Γιλβέρτ' λήφθηκε από 3 μοναχούς της Εκκλησίας που ίδρυσαν 3 μοναχίτιδες. Οι μοναχίτιδες ίδρυσαν για τιμή τους τους αγίους. 3 μοναχοί. '3' είναι το σημαντικότερο. 3 μοναχίτιδες. Ονομάζουν οι φίλοι και τις κόρες τους. 'Οι' - 'οι'.

in_latin.name: Gilbertina
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Gilbertina originem habet ex lingua Anglica. Significatio eius est 'filia Gilberti'. Nomen in multis patronis, includens patronis Ecclesiae, invenitur. In patronis, significatio nominis 'scara' vel 'socius'. Item, 'mulier Gilberti'. Nomen ipsa 'Gilberti' ab 3 monachis Ecclesiae, quae 3 monachitates condiderunt, acceptum est. Monachitates condiderunt pro honoribus eorum sanctorum. 3 monachi. '3' est numerus gravissimus. 3 monachitates. Ipsi nomina amicis et filias suas. 'Ei' - 'eae'.

in_english.name: Gilbertine
in_english.meaning: feminine given name derived from Gilbertine family
in_english.long_meaning: The name Gilbertine originates from the English language, meaning 'daughter of Gilbert'. The name is found in numerous patronages, including patronages of the Church. In patronages, the meaning of the name 'scorpion' or 'associate'. Also, 'woman of Gilbert'. The name itself 'Gilbert' was adopted by 3 monastic monks who founded 3 monastic houses. They founded the monastic houses in honor of their holy saints. 3 monks. '3' is the most significant. 3 monastic houses. They named their friends and daughters. 'They' - 'them'.

data.cultural_impact: The name Gilbertine was often given to daughters of noble families in the Middle Ages, and may have been associated with the Gilbertine Order of monastic nuns, founded by St. Gilbert of Saints in the 11th century. The name therefore carries an air of privilege and nobility, as well as a connection to the rich history of medieval Christianity.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Gilbertine speaks to the promise and pledge made to God, to live a life in devotion and service to Him. The etymology of the name reminds us that our lives are a gift from God, and that we should make the most of this gift by living a bright and shining example of faith and virtue. The name also inspires us to remember the wisdom of St. Gilbert and the teachings of the Gilbertine Order, which emphasize humility, obedience, and community.
